Source Monster

Monster: Duramboros | CR: 9 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

FastCharge. When you roll for initiative, your greatsword, longsword, charge blade, or tonfas gains 1 charge, spirit, or phial charge.

Armor Effect

While you wear this armor, you can use your reaction to grant yourself @variantrule[Advantage|XPHB] on any @skill[Acrobatics] check. Once used, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

Tags: mechanic:class-feature, mechanic:reaction, mechanic:advantage, mechanic:short-rest, mechanic:long-rest
